trial_title: A 12 Month Site Randomized Trial in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and History of Cardiovascular Disease
brief_summary: COORDINATE-Diabetes is a cluster-randomized clinical trial to test the effectiveness of an innovative, clinic-level educational intervention to improve the management of patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and cardiovascular disease.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented history of cardiovascular disease, specifically including coronary artery disease or a prior cerebrovascular accident?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes mellitus (DMII).

eligibility_table.criterion: History of at least one of the following conditions:
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of multiple relevant conditions including CAD, HTN, HL, and PVD.

eligibility_table.criterion: Coronary artery disease (defined as prior MI, coronary revascularization (CABG or PCI), and/or obstructive CAD (≥50%) as documented by angiography or CTA)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of coronary artery disease, evidenced by prior CABG.
The patient has significant bilateral carotid artery stenosis, with 90% stenosis of the left ICA.

eligibility_table.criterion: Peripheral Arterial disease (defined as claudication with ABI<0.9, prior peripheral revascularization, and/or amputation due to circulatory insufficiency)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has moderate to severe peripheral vascular disease (PVD).

eligibility_table.criterion: Ability to communicate with site staff and understand and provide written informed consent and proof of Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) authorization
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is able to communicate and provide informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Determined to be highly unlikely to survive and/or to continue follow-up in that clinic for at least 1 year, as identified by site investigator
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's overall health status and multiple comorbidities raise concerns about long-term survival and follow-up.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's estimated 1-year survival probability less than 50% based on their current health status and comorbidities?

eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's estimated glomerular filtration rate (GFR) less than 30 mL/min/1.73m²?

eligibility_table.criterion: Already on all guideline-recommended therapies for T2DM and CVD
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been documented to be on all guideline-recommended therapies for T2DM and CVD.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently taking all guideline-recommended medications for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and cardiovascular disease, including metformin, a GLP-1 receptor agonist or SGLT2 inhibitor, and a statin?

eligibility_table.criterion: Absolute contraindication to any of the guideline recommended therapies for T2DM and CVD
eligibility_table.justification: There is no clear documentation of absolute contraindications to guideline-recommended therapies, but the patient's multiple conditions warrant caution.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any documented history of severe allergic reactions or adverse effects to any of the guideline-recommended therapies for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and cardiovascular disease?
